exposure: fetal reduction from twins to singleton
outcome: preterm birth prior to 37 gestational weeks
preterm birth prior to 34 gestational weeks
cohort: Dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies, some of which underwent fetal reduction to singleton, and others which continued as twin gestations.
finding: Fetal reduction from twins to singleton significantly reduces the risk of preterm birth prior to 37 gestational weeks, but not for more severe maternal and perinatal complications.
